sources.title: Digital Connectivity Infrastructure Guidance
sources.evidence_location: official HTML purpose and policy sections
facts: Guidance was adopted on 20 November 2024
It addresses London Plan Policy SI 6
It covers new and existing development proposals
It addresses infrastructure provision, interference avoidance and public-realm integration
limitations: Planning guidance does not prove deployment or current service
Application preparation information is not parcel orderability
sources.licence: London City Hall official HTML; attribution retained

sources.title: Broadband connectivity in London
sources.evidence_kind: London Assembly investigation scope and background evidence
sources.evidence_location: official HTML key issues and terms of reference
facts: Investigation was adopted on 19 February 2025
The page reports 86.4% London gigabit-capable availability as of 2024
It reports 224,000 premises unable to obtain gigabit-capable broadband
It reports 29,000 premises receiving less than 30 Mbit/s
limitations: Investigation-level aggregates are not current parcel truth
sources.licence: London City Hall official HTML; attribution retained

sources.title: January 2026: Premises contracted and built under Project Gigabit contracts
sources.evidence_location: official HTML overview and contract table
facts: Snapshot date is 20 January 2026
Values are rounded to the nearest 10
Contracted premises cover initial contract scope only
The publication warns against using the figures to assess contractual milestones
limitations: Management information is not directly comparable with official statistics
Contract totals cannot be assigned to a parcel

sources.title: February 2026: Premises contracted and built under Project Gigabit contracts
facts: Publication reports February 2026 Project Gigabit contract management information
Contracted premises include initial contract scope only
Deferred-scope premises may not be included
The publication is Crown copyright 2026 under OGL v3.0 where stated
limitations: Contract management information is not live service availability
No parcel assignment without exact contract, UPRN and provider evidence

sources.title: April 2026: Premises contracted and built under Project Gigabit contracts
facts: Snapshot date is 22 April 2026
Contracted premises cover initial contract scope only
Deferred-scope premises may not be reflected
The publication warns that ingestion lag prevents milestone assessment
limitations: Built contract counts do not prove retail orderability
Monthly totals cannot be assigned to a parcel
